newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ricchetti H1 1996 net 4.5 bln lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ricchetti H1 1996 net 4.5 bln lire.

text.p: Italian ceramics firm Gruppo Ceramiche Ricchetti SpA, newly listed on the Milan bourse, said it posted first half 1996 net profit of 4.5 billion lire compared to 4.2 billion lire for 1995 as a whole.
The Modena-based company is one of the largest manufacturers of ceramic tiles for walls and floors in Italy which is the world's leading producer and exporter of ceramic tiles.
The company was listed on the stock exchange last month.
At 1018 GMT its stock traded down 48 lire at 1,889 lire.
First half consolidated operating profit was 11.9 billion lire on net sales of 128.3 billion.
The figures were not directly comparable with the first half 1995 because of changes at the consolidated level.

The company said that despite the unfavourable trading conditions in the domestic market, the group's second half 1996 sales levels are expected to remain substantially in line with those achieved in the first half.

"Overall, notwithstanding the future negative impact of currency effects in July, August and September, the group continues to believe that year-end results will continue the positive trend set in the first half," a statement said.
